# Temple Scroll Column 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 15 | **Condition:** better preserved

---

**15:1** On the fifth day: nine young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**15:2** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**15:3** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**15:4** On the sixth day: eight young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**15:5** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**15:6** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**15:7** On the seventh day: seven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**15:8** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**15:9** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**15:10** You are to present all these to the LORD at your appointed festivals, along with your vow offerings and your voluntary offerings —

**15:11** whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or fellowship offerings.

**15:12** Moses told the Israelites everything the LORD had commanded him.

**15:13** [blank line in manuscript]

**15:14** [blank line in manuscript]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 15 completes the Sukkot sacrificial sequence, with the bull count descending from nine to seven over the final three days. The seventy total bulls across the seven days symbolically represent the nations of the world in later Jewish tradition. The concluding formula and blank lines mark a major structural division — the end of the festival calendar and preparation for the eighth-day assembly instructions.*
